info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Production Release Management API
info.description: The Production Release Management API enables businesses to streamline their production release processes within the IT banking sector. This endpoint facilitates the submission of production release requests, allowing teams to manage deployments efficiently. It is primarily utilized by IT managers and operations teams seeking to enhance release coordination and ensure smooth transitions in the production environment. By centralizing the release requests, organizations can optimize their workflows and minimize disruption to services.

post.summary: Initiates a new production release in the IT management system.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new production release, ensuring that the latest changes and features are deployed to the production environment effectively. Please provide all necessary details in the request body to facilitate the release process.

requestBody.description: This request body is used for creating a new production release in the IT management system. It should contain all necessary information regarding the release, including relevant details such as version, release notes, and deployment schedule.

201.description: Resource created successfully and the production release is completed.
